messages:
maya: Heads-up — opened PR to add a fallback profile for ember-3b when KV cache misses spike. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/572 Please :eyes: if you have a sec.

sanjay: ping — I'll take a look in ~30m. what's failing in CI?

maya: unit tests pass locally, but we're seeing flakiness on linux-gpu-2 during quant-compat. Logs show `IndexError: token offset out of range` on tokenizer step. Not sure if it's an edge-case from the recent byte-level tokenizer tweak.

olivia: can you paste the diff or the config fragment you're adding?

maya: here's the fallback profile snippet I added:
```
# model_profiles/ember-3b/fallback.json
{
  "max_sequence": 8192,
  "max_cache_prefix": 128,
  "quant_profile": "s8-fast",
  "tokenizer_config": {
    "handle_invalid_bytes": "replace",
    "strip_accents": false
  }
}
```
I also added a small guard in tokenizer to return an empty token for empty bytes.

ci-bot: build #4721 — linux-gpu-2 failed (quant-compat), see logs: https://ci.redwood/4721

sanjay: taking it now. I'll try to reproduce the IndexError with the new profile.

olivia: quick thought — the earlier change to `strip_accents` caused some offsets to shift for certain unicode combos. If tests expect byte offsets, that could trigger the error.

maya: good call. I can try changing `strip_accents` to true in the profile and push a commit. That should be a minimal change to test.

sanjay: I ran the failing test locally with the previous tokenizer settings and it passes; with the new config it fails. Looks like `handle_invalid_bytes: replace` + `strip_accents: false` combo is the culprit. I'll add a quick fix to the tokenizer to clamp offsets as well.

olivia: FYI I left two nit comments on the PR about naming, otherwise LGTM once CI passes. :+1:

sanjay: pushed fix to clamp offsets and added a unit test for the empty-byte case.

ci-bot: build #4722 triggered by sanjay — linux-gpu-2: running.

ci-bot: build #4722 — all checks passed.

olivia: :eyes: re-reviewed, approving now.

maya: thanks both! planning to merge after the deploy window opens tomorrow morning. If anyone needs it earlier ping me and I'll try to bump.

devex-bot: reminder — merge window for ember-models group is 09:00-10:00 UTC. Please ensure deploy notes are added.

maya: added deploy note to PR and changelog. will merge at 09:05 UTC tomorrow if no objections. :thumbsup:
